name: Handbook & Craft Opt
description: An improved recipe browser for Vintage Story that works alongside the vanilla Handbook. It makes recipes easier to find with search, mod filters, recent recipes, and ingredient-based lookup. Recipe tooltips show which materials you have, what is missing, and how many batches you can make, including reusable tools. The mod also optimizes crafting-grid recipe matching and ingredient handling to avoid unnecessary work while browsing and crafting, especially in modded games. The vanilla Handbook remains available as usual.
